title: Agent's first message is not sent after the folder-trust question is answered
summary: After a fresh folder-trust answer Claude Code stays silent up to 2.5 s before echoing typed text, so Grillo's Enter after 0.5 s of silence was lost; Enter now waits for the echo (10 s at most). Tested in the real app, 3 of 3 untrusted folders.

deferred.what: The meeting panel greets an agent (types `session: ...` then Enter) once its waiting dot shows after 3 s of silence; in a never-trusted folder where Claude Code stays silent 3 s or more after drawing its input, that line is typed straight after the still-unsent `/grillo-meeting`, and both go out as one message `/grillo-meetingsession: ...`.
deferred.why: Pre-existing and outside issue #177's seam (src/main/features/agents/); the fix is for the meeting panel to greet only once the first message's Enter is pressed.
